# VeriPura

> VeriPura builds orchestrated compliance agents. They find the rules that apply to a shipment, product or job, check every document against them, and record a result anyone can verify. Each industry solution is built on VeriPura Core, our engine.

## Key facts

- VeriPura gives information, not decisions. It reports findings to review and fix, and the customer's team makes the decision.
- Only VeriPura Food is live. Building Supplies, Cosmetics, Supplements and Pharma are examples of what VeriPura Core can be tuned for.
- Teams can use VeriPura through the portal, or call the agents from their own systems through the hosted API. Teams can also connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant with the same partner key. MCP access is read-only and limited to the customer's own consignments, with the same rules as the API. Submitting documents from an assistant is under development.
- Pilots start with one real consignment.
- When VeriPura Core cannot check something, it says so. A missing document is a finding, and an offline register shows as Not checked, never as a match.
- VeriPura Core labels every capability Live or Under development. Core reads documents by content, cross-checks them, chases missing papers, screens suppliers and records every document on a tamper-evident trail anchored on a public blockchain.
- The orchestration and verification approach is covered under VeriPura's USPTO filing, U.S. provisional patent application 64/088,697.

## Pages

- [VeriPura home](https://www.veripura.com/): VeriPura™ builds 70+ orchestrated compliance agents that find rules, check trade documents, and record verifiable results across regulated supply chains.
- [VeriPura Core](https://www.veripura.com/core.html): VeriPura Core™ checks shipment documents against destination rules, reports what could not be checked, and records verifiable results for supply chains.
- [VeriPura Food (live)](https://www.veripura.com/food.html): VeriPura Food™ checks every shipment document against border import requirements of any destination before the container moves. Powered by VeriPura Core.
- [VeriPura Food cost estimator](https://www.veripura.com/food-estimator.html): An open estimator. Enter your own hours, shipment volume, rejections and delays to see what document review costs your team today and what VeriPura Food™ could change. Figures come from the visitor's inputs and assumptions, not from benchmarks.
- [VeriPura Building Supplies (example)](https://www.veripura.com/building-supplies.html): VeriPura Building Supplies™ checks origin, duty, timber, forced-labor, and carbon documents against destination requirements before materials ship.
- [VeriPura Cosmetics (example)](https://www.veripura.com/cosmetics.html): VeriPura Cosmetics™ checks formulas, labels, claims, and registrations against the requirements of any destination before cosmetic products ship.
- [VeriPura Supplements (example)](https://www.veripura.com/supplements.html): VeriPura Supplements™ checks ingredients, dosage limits, claims, and certificates against destination requirements before vitamins and supplements ship.
- [VeriPura Pharma (example)](https://www.veripura.com/pharmaceuticals.html): VeriPura Pharma™ checks licences, GMP certificates, batch, and cold-chain records against destination requirements before pharmaceutical products ship.

## Guides

- [Guides for importers](https://www.veripura.com/guides/): Plain, sourced guides to import rules for food, cosmetics, building supplies, supplements and pharmaceuticals. Information for importers, not legal advice.
- [Halal label requirements for Indonesia](https://www.veripura.com/guides/halal-label-requirements-indonesia.html): Indonesia halal rules for imported food from 17 October 2026: label rules, foreign certificate registration, shipment checks, and pre-print checklist.
- [FDA Prior Notice checklist for food imports into the US](https://www.veripura.com/guides/fda-prior-notice-checklist.html): When to submit FDA Prior Notice, what information it needs, what happens without it, and checks to run before you submit.
- [Documents needed to import food into the EU](https://www.veripura.com/guides/eu-food-import-documents.html): The customs documents, certificates and CHED filings food needs to enter the EU, by animal and non-animal origin, with checks to run before shipping.
- [Documents needed to import food into the UK](https://www.veripura.com/guides/uk-food-import-documents.html): The customs documents, health certificates and CHED notifications food needs to enter Great Britain, with checks to run before shipping.
- [US food label requirements for imported food](https://www.veripura.com/guides/us-food-label-requirements.html): The statements FDA expects on a packaged food label, the allergen rules, country of origin marking by US Customs, and checks to run before you print.
- [EU food label requirements for imported food](https://www.veripura.com/guides/eu-food-label-requirements.html): The mandatory particulars on an EU food label, the allergen rules, language and minimum text size, and checks to run before you print.
- [Bill of lading errors that cause port delays](https://www.veripura.com/guides/bill-of-lading-errors.html): Which bill of lading fields customs systems use, the mismatches that give officials a reason to ask questions, and a checklist for reviewing the draft.
- [Certificate of origin and HS code mistakes on food shipments](https://www.veripura.com/guides/origin-and-hs-code-mistakes.html): How HS codes and proof of origin work, the mismatches customs authorities can compare across documents, and a checklist to run before you ship.
- [Cosmetics label and product file checks for EU and US sales](https://www.veripura.com/guides/cosmetics-label-and-file-checks.html): What EU Cosmetics Regulation, US MoCRA, and FDA labeling rules expect on cosmetic labels and records, and the mismatches to check before you ship.
- [Lacey Act declaration and wood import checks for lumber into the US](https://www.veripura.com/guides/lacey-act-lumber-import-checks.html): What the US Lacey Act requires for imported plants and wood products, how APHIS says to file declarations, and mismatches to check before shipping.
- [Dietary supplement label and claim checks for US and EU sales](https://www.veripura.com/guides/supplement-label-and-claim-checks.html): What US FDA rules and the EU food supplements directive expect on a supplement label and in its claims, and the mismatches to check before you ship.
- [Medicine import checks for the EU and US: authorisations and registrations](https://www.veripura.com/guides/medicine-import-checks-eu-us.html): What EU law and US FDA rules require for imported medicines: batch certification, registration, and the document records to check before a batch ships.
